640-4279-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
640-4279-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1169-4311-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5078-6766-7296-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1734-2150-4247.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

586-944-5258-5618-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

791-3629-8089.easyPrerequisites: Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
791-3629-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
791-3629-8089.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

394-586-864-3125-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-586-864-3125-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Desecrated Tomb.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

4567-7688.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 22 minus Greven's power rounded down to the nearest multiple of 3.
4567-7688.description:
Activate M.O.D.O.K. by paying 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

457-1409-7161-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Mouser by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Arcbound Mouser leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with a +1/+1 counter due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Arcbound Mouser
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Arcbound Mouser when it left the battlefield.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Arcbound Mouser and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

413-6553-7424.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-4478-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-2525-3763-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
413-2525-3763-6749.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Body Double from your hand onto the battlefield tapped. Choose to have Body Double enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Body Double enters, Blasting Station and Paleoloth trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Paleoloth trigger, returning Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Blasting Station and Paleoloth trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Paleoloth trigger, returning Body Double from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 7.
Repeat.

4050-4477-7364.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa and another nontoken creature, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Continue? by paying {1}{W}, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and at least one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Continue? from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
4050-4477-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to two additional creatures each loop to net mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7236.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Towering Titan.
When Towering Titan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2919-3000-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-3000-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

624-5282-7149.description:
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Phantasmal Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Phantasmal Image enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Phantasmal Image leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Phantasmal Image from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-2713-5140-7061.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2713-5140-7061.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

123-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Highspire Artisan.
When Highspire Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Highspire Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1414-4195-4574-5849.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lotus Petal from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3293-5412-5478-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-5412-5478-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5412-5478-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2034-2079-2820-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

2060-3750-6113.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has power 5 or greater, does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2060-3750-6113.description:
Deal combat damage using Crystalline Crawler.
Quilled Greatwurm triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

198-1651-2585-2645.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least four charge counters on it.
198-1651-2585-2645.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Staff of Domination and Grim Monolith, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {4}, untapping it.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities and/or untap any artifact(s) you control.

859-1006.notablePrerequisites:
Wolfhunter's Quiver attached to Lurking Roper.
You have a way to give Lurking Roper lifelink.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
859-1006.description:
Give Lurking Roper lifelink, if needed.
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

770-2397-4720-4829.notablePrerequisites: At least nine of your ten sticker sheets have a name sicker with four unique vowels.
770-2397-4720-4829.description:
Cast _____ Goblin by paying {2}{R}.
_____ Goblin enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, getting two name stickers and adding at least eight {R}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Cast Man-o'-War by paying {2}{U}.
Man-o'-War enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning itself and _____ Goblin from the battlefield to your hand and returning any stickers on them to your sticker sheets.
Repeat.

3222-3858.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least twenty.
3222-3858.description:
Cast Minion of the Wastes by paying {3}{B}{B}{B}.
Choose to pay nineteen life as Minion of the Wastes enters the battlefield, causing it to be a 19/19 creature.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life, and win the game.

1789-2232-4050-4081.description:
Cast Mothdust Changeling by paying {U}.
Mothdust Changeling enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Lathliss.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Mothdust Changeling from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Dragon token, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2724-3194-3557.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Brago. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

651-2342-2603.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor's first ability by paying {0}, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve Shaman en-Kor's ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Shaman en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Task Force instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Worthy Cause by paying {W} and sacrificing Task Force, causing you to gain life equal to Task Force's toughness.
